## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run check:harness` when agent instructions, docs, skills, package READMEs, MCP setup, routing, or Codex configuration changed
- [ ] Tests added/updated if needed
- [ ] Current docs updated for major behavior, workflow, package, schema, scaffold, lifecycle, or toolchain changes

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] No sensitive data added
- [ ] No unrelated changes included
- [ ] Agent instructions/docs updated when routing or workflow guidance changed
- [ ] Harness changes preserve host-conversation authority and do not add unchecked trust, plugins, or role/sandbox claims
- [ ] Scaffold preparation run and template diffs reviewed when scaffold-relevant source changed
- [ ] Generated artifacts reviewed and explained when included
- [ ] MCP docs/setup updated when tool or transport behavior changed
